development.what: the dev seeds the plateau window and the draws per stack were chosen on, and the draws each plane searches (grid draw 0 = the run seed, draw k = <seed>:draw<k>; the synthetic searched slices)

heldOut.what: the fresh draws the loop never searches and never reads: the grid fresh seeds and the synthetic fresh slices

split.contaminated: the bar fresh seeds were printed during development (development.barSeedExposures) before the 250 ms plateau window was chosen, so the choice is not blind to them

bar.rule: the 300 s run prints score gained per million organism-years above zero on both planes with the plateau second named, and the projection carries its arithmetic

perPlane.projectionArithmetic: projection: 1,000,000,000 organism-years / 1,676.6 generations per wall second (measured: 502,991 generations in 300.000 s) = 596,433 s (165.7 h), a projection, not a measurement
projection: 1,000,000,000 organism-years / 2,303.1 generations per wall second (measured: 690,928 generations in 300.000 s) = 434,199 s (120.6 h), a projection, not a measurement

statement: One organism-year is declared to be one generation of the whole population on a plane (64 children, 64 evaluations), so organism-years equal generations. On the grid plane the loop ran 502,991 organism-years in 300.000 s and the searched best's score on the fresh draw grid/velocity:heldout, which the loop never searched or read, went from 49 to 148 of 160, 196.823 tasks gained per million organism-years; its first plateau was at 0.400 s (the searched score last rose before it at 0.100 s), and it grew 4 times by widening, 120 by ingesting a new draw and 545 by spawning. That fresh score first reached its highest, 152, at 136.321 s and never went higher; from half the wall to the end it moved by -3. On the synthetic plane it ran 690,928 organism-years in 300.000 s and went from 89 to 256 of 256 on years/synthetic:fresh0, 241.704 per million organism-years, first plateau at 0.400 s. At the grid run's measured 1676.6 generations per wall second, one billion organism-years would take 596,433 s (165.7 h): a projection, not a measurement. With growth off (the control, 300 s) the grid plane went from 49 to 109 on the same fresh draw. The bar's fresh seeds were printed during development (a 3 s smoke run at a 2000 ms window, before the 250 ms window was chosen; development.barSeedExposures names every run that saw them). The machine was shared with other builders, so every rate is a contended wall-clock rate; no model was called.

plateauRule.unit: searched score (mean tasks per draw minus length / 257) per wall second

development.chose: windowDraws 8 over 4 (60 s runs, window 2000 ms: fresh 145 against 141 on years/dev, 140 against 131 on years/dev2); then the plateau window 250 ms over 500 and 2000 (60 s runs, window 8 draws: mean fresh over the two dev seeds 146.5 at 250 ms, 141.0 at 500, 143.0 at 2000; one seed each, noise about 5 tasks); prefetch on, and the loop spawns instead of waiting when the next draw is still building

barSeedExposures.after: the plateau window went from 2000 ms to 250 ms after this smoke run. The 250 ms choice is recorded above as made on the dev seeds, but it was made after these bar-seed scores had been printed, so it cannot be certified blind to them

barSeedExposures.printed: the grid 10 s and 60 s runs on the bar seeds; killed about 240 s in, no verdict written
barSeedExposures.after: no search parameter changed after it
